caption: The drawing depicts a single object consisting of a glass and metal lamp or candle holder set against a plain beige background. The base is metallic and colored in shades of brown and gold, with a round, tiered form. It has a wide, circular bottom that narrows into a column before flaring into another rounded platform that supports the glass component. The glass portion is clear with a subtle blue-gray tint and features a patterned texture with diamond shapes and oval accents in its lower half. The upper part of the glass is smooth and cylindrical, flaring outward in a tulip shape with a scalloped rim. The composition is centered, with the object occupying most of the vertical space, and the artist's signature is present in the lower right corner.
title: Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
